name: Local Model Server Client
description: Async abstraction over local inference servers (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp). Implements a LocalModelClient Protocol (structural typing) as the public contract with concrete implementations per backend using composition. Handles model loading status checks, health checks, inference requests, and model version swapping on fine-tuned model promotion. Returns structured LocalModelUnavailable status (not an exception) when no model exists yet (Phase 1) or server is down. On model promotion: loads new model, runs smoke test, swaps to new version atomically, unloads old. All operational failures are captured in return value types — never crashes the system on local model failure. Only programming errors (wrong types, missing config) raise exceptions. Uses asyncio.Lock for promotion serialization. Accepts optional httpx.AsyncClient via dependency injection for testability. Structured JSON logging at all decision points.

types.name: InferenceSuccess

fields.name: result_type
fields.description: Discriminator field. Always 'success' for this variant.

types.description: Successful inference result from any local backend. Backend-agnostic — concrete clients normalize their backend-specific responses into this shape. Tagged with result_type='success' for discriminated union.

types.name: LocalModelUnavailable

fields.name: result_type
fields.description: Discriminator field. Always 'unavailable' for this variant.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Categorized reason why the local model is unavailable.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Human-readable detail message for logging and diagnostics.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Which backend was attempted.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Correlated request identifier from the InferenceRequest.

fields.name: latency_ms
fields.description: Time spent before determining unavailability, in milliseconds.

types.description: Structured unavailability result. NOT an exception — this is a normal return value indicating the local model cannot serve the request. Tagged with result_type='unavailable' for discriminated union.

types.name: InferenceResult
types.description: Discriminated union of inference outcomes. Discriminator field is 'result_type'. Exactly one of InferenceSuccess or LocalModelUnavailable. The caller (Router) pattern-matches on result_type to decide whether to fall back to remote.

types.name: HealthStatus

fields.name: is_alive
fields.description: Whether the server process is reachable (HTTP connectivity).

fields.name: is_ready
fields.description: Whether the server has a model loaded and is ready to serve inference. is_ready implies is_alive.

fields.name: loaded_model
fields.description: Identifier of the currently loaded model, or empty string if none.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Which backend this health status is for.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Human-readable reason when not alive or not ready.

fields.name: latency_ms
fields.description: Time taken for the health check in milliseconds.

types.description: Structured health check result for a local inference server. Not a boolean — carries sufficient detail for the Router to make routing decisions and for audit logging.

types.name: PromotionResult

fields.name: status
fields.description: Outcome status of the promotion attempt.

fields.name: previous_model_id
fields.description: Model identifier that was active before promotion, or empty if no model was loaded.

fields.name: new_model_id
fields.description: Model identifier that was requested for promotion.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the new model is now the active model. True only when status is 'success'.

fields.name: smoke_test_passed
fields.description: Whether the smoke test passed. False if smoke test was not run (e.g., load_failed).

fields.name: smoke_test_response
fields.description: The actual response from the smoke test inference, for audit logging.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Human-readable detail message on failure, empty on success.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.description: Total wall-clock time for the promotion operation in milliseconds.

types.description: Result of a model promotion attempt. Captures old/new model versions, smoke test outcome, and whether the swap was committed. On failure, the old model remains active and the reason is captured.

types.name: BaseClientConfig

validators.error_message: promotion_lock_timeout_s must be between 10.0 and 900.0 seconds.

functions.name: infer
functions.description: Send an inference request to the local model server and return the result. Returns InferenceSuccess on successful generation, or LocalModelUnavailable when the server cannot fulfill the request for any operational reason. Never raises exceptions for expected failures (network errors, timeouts, server down, no model loaded). Only raises for programming errors (invalid request types). The caller (Router) pattern-matches on result_type to decide routing. Structured logging emits inference latency, model used, token counts, and any unavailability reasons.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The inference request containing prompt, generation parameters, and optional request correlation ID.

error_cases.name: invalid_request_type
error_cases.condition: request is not an InferenceRequest instance or fails Pydantic validation.

error_data.description: Programming error — caller passed wrong type. This is the only case that raises.

preconditions: Client has been initialized via async context manager (__aenter__) or explicit initialization.
postconditions: Return value is exactly one of InferenceSuccess or LocalModelUnavailable.
Return value always contains a non-empty request_id (generated if not provided in request).
Return value always contains latency_ms >= 0.
Return value always contains the backend type that was attempted.
If result_type is 'success', text is non-empty and model_id is non-empty.
If result_type is 'unavailable', reason is a valid UnavailableReason variant.
Structured log entry emitted with inference outcome, latency, and request_id.
side_effects: Performs HTTP request to local inference server.
Emits structured JSON log entry with inference outcome.

structured_side_effects.description: POST request with prompt and generation parameters to the configured backend.
Structured JSON log with request_id, model_id, latency_ms, tokens_generated, result_type, and unavailable_reason if applicable.

functions.name: health
functions.description: Perform a health check against the local inference server. Returns a structured HealthStatus with is_alive (server reachable), is_ready (model loaded and serving), loaded model identifier, and diagnostic detail. Uses the configured health_check_timeout_s. Never raises for operational failures — returns HealthStatus with is_alive=false on network errors. Callers should not cache this result beyond a few seconds; the Router calls this to gate local inference attempts.
preconditions: Client has been initialized via async context manager or explicit initialization.
postconditions: Return value is always a valid HealthStatus.
If is_ready is true, then is_alive is also true.
If is_ready is true, loaded_model is non-empty.
If is_alive is false, is_ready is false.
latency_ms reflects actual time spent on health check.
Structured log entry emitted on health state transitions (alive->dead, ready->not_ready, model change).
side_effects: Performs HTTP health check request to local inference server.
Emits structured JSON log on health transitions.

structured_side_effects.description: GET request to backend-specific health/status endpoint with health_check_timeout_s.
Structured JSON log on health state transitions (not every call — only when state changes from previous check).

functions.name: promote_model
functions.description: Perform a blue-green model swap: load the new model, run a smoke test inference, and if successful, atomically swap the active model reference and unload the old model. Serialized via asyncio.Lock — concurrent promotion attempts return lock_timeout. The old model continues serving inference during the entire promotion process. On any failure (load, smoke test, timeout), the old model remains active and the failure is fully captured in PromotionResult. Backend-specific: Ollama pulls/loads model; vLLM may require server restart (returns load_failed with detail); llama.cpp loads new GGUF file.

inputs.name: new_model_id
inputs.description: Identifier of the new model to promote (e.g., Ollama model tag, vLLM model path, llama.cpp GGUF path).

inputs.name: smoke_test_prompt
inputs.description: Prompt to use for the smoke test inference after loading the new model.

inputs.name: expected_substring
inputs.description: If non-empty, the smoke test response must contain this substring (case-insensitive) to pass. If empty, any non-empty response passes the smoke test.

error_cases.name: invalid_model_id_type
error_cases.condition: new_model_id is not a string or is empty after stripping.

error_data.description: Programming error — new_model_id must be a non-empty string.

error_cases.name: invalid_smoke_test_prompt
error_cases.condition: smoke_test_prompt is not a string or is empty after stripping.

error_data.description: Programming error — smoke_test_prompt must be a non-empty string.

preconditions: Client has been initialized via async context manager or explicit initialization.
postconditions: If status is 'success': is_active is true, smoke_test_passed is true, the new model is now the active model, and the old model has been unloaded (best-effort).
If status is 'already_active': new_model_id matches the currently active model, no work is done, is_active is true.
If status is 'smoke_test_failed': the old model remains active, is_active is false, smoke_test_response contains the failing response.
If status is 'load_failed': the old model remains active, is_active is false, detail contains the failure reason.
If status is 'server_unavailable': the server was not reachable, is_active is false.
If status is 'lock_timeout': another promotion is in progress, is_active is false.
previous_model_id reflects the model that was active when promotion started (empty if none).
duration_ms reflects total wall-clock time of the promotion attempt.
Structured log entry emitted with full promotion details including status, old/new model IDs, smoke test outcome, and duration.
side_effects: Loads new model on inference server.
Swaps active model reference on success.
Emits structured JSON log entries for each promotion step.

structured_side_effects.target: Local inference server model management API
structured_side_effects.description: Sequence of HTTP calls: load/pull new model, smoke test inference, unload old model.
Atomically swaps the active model identifier after successful smoke test. Protected by asyncio.Lock.
Structured JSON log entries for: promotion started, model load result, smoke test result, swap committed/rolled back, old model unloaded, total duration.

functions.name: get_active_model
functions.description: Return the identifier of the currently active (loaded and serving) model, or empty string if no model is loaded. This is a local read of the client's tracked state, not a server call. To verify the server's actual state, use health() instead.
preconditions: Client has been initialized via async context manager or explicit initialization.
postconditions: Returns the model identifier string that was last successfully promoted/loaded, or empty string if no model has been loaded.
The returned value matches the model_id field in InferenceSuccess results.
This is a local memory read with no I/O — returns immediately.

structured_side_effects.description: Pure local state read, no I/O.

invariants: All operational failures (network errors, timeouts, server unavailable, model not loaded) are represented as return values (LocalModelUnavailable or PromotionResult with failure status), never as exceptions.
Only programming errors (wrong types, invalid arguments, missing config) raise exceptions.
The active model reference is only updated after a successful smoke test during promotion. The old model continues serving during the entire promotion process.
Model promotion is serialized via asyncio.Lock — at most one promotion runs at a time per client instance.
All public methods are async (coroutines) and must be awaited.
Concrete client instances are async context managers (__aenter__/__aexit__) that manage httpx.AsyncClient lifecycle. An optional pre-constructed httpx.AsyncClient can be injected for testing.
HealthStatus.is_ready implies HealthStatus.is_alive — a server cannot be ready without being alive.
Every InferenceResult (success or unavailable) carries a non-empty request_id for audit log correlation.
Structured JSON logging is emitted at all decision points: inference outcomes, health transitions, promotion events. Uses logging.getLogger(__name__) per module.
Configuration is validated at construction time via Pydantic strict mode — invalid config raises ValidationError at startup, never at runtime.
Each concrete implementation file (ollama_client.py, vllm_client.py, llamacpp_client.py) stays under 300 lines.
LocalModelClient is a Protocol (structural typing), not an ABC. Concrete implementations satisfy the protocol through duck typing, not inheritance.
